messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock the surge acceptance criteria for reserved pools GA. ACME and PayCo pushed back on "priority spillover" last week, and Legal wants clear SLA language by EOD Friday.
raj: Can we list the actual knobs we want to expose? I suggest: max-burst-per-tenant, prewarm-credit-rate, autoscale-hysteresis-ms.
lisa: From SRE: main risk is tail latency during spill. If we allow >3x burst without prewarm, 95p latency goes to crap. Need a hard cap or graceful throttling path.
matt: Rollout plan idea: feature-flagged opt-in for first 3 customers, metric gates (error% < 0.5, 95p latency < 250ms) for full opt-in. If gates fail, auto-fallback to soft-throttle. Thoughts?
jun: ACME said they need at least one predictable burst window per day for batch spikes. They prefer deterministic prewarm credits over ephemeral bursts. PayCo asked for legal language on credit expiry.
raj: Proposal draft for knobs (small snippet):
```json
{
  "max_burst_per_tenant": 200,
  "prewarm_credit_rate": "10/min",
  "autoscale_hysteresis_ms": 120000
}
```
this is just a starting point.
lisa: Two operational asks: 1) an emergency drain command for a tenant that can be invoked by oncall, 2) telemetry tags for "spill_via_burst" vs "spill_preemptive" so we can break down causes.
anya: Agreed. Add both to launch checklist. Also add a written fallback sequence so CS can tell customers what happens when quotas hit.
matt: For gating metrics, can we use the existing per-route dashboards? Raj, can you add the new metrics to the per-route tile (95p latency, burst_retries, prewarm_usage)?
raj: Yep. I'll add metrics and a Prom rule for the gate. ETA Thursday.
jun: Customer comms: I'll draft opt-in email + contract appendix language for credit expirations and SLA exceptions. Want legal in loop — looping @anya.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled-canary for reserved-pool-burst v1 on staging at 2025-07-18T03:00Z (will notify on success/failure).
anya: OK next steps: (1) Raj adds metrics + Prom gates (due Thu), (2) Lisa adds emergency drain + telemetry tags, (3) Jun drafts comms + contract appendix, (4) Matt prepares rollout playbook with gate thresholds. We'll review Wed 10am.
lisa: One more note — include an ops-runbook snippet for when spill causes cascade: short checklist, who to page (SRE lead), rollback steps.
anya: Good call. I'll start the checklist and share PR.
matt: Thanks team. If anyone finds an edge case (multi-region cross-tenant spill), drop it in this thread.
jun: ACME asked: can we guarantee at least one 30s 2x burst per day? That seems like a product decision.
anya: We'll treat that as a signed SLA add-on — product + legal to finalize. Adding it to backlog item: "contracted-burst-window".
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary completed — 0 failures.
anya: Nice. See you Wed 10am for final signoff. :thumbsup:
